name: abap-cleaner-vscode-dev
description: Automated ABAP cleaner formatting and linting.

abapCleaner.abapRelease.description: Optional target ABAP release used to gate release-sensitive cleanup rules.

abapCleaner.lint.enabled.description: Publish diagnostics for cleanup rules that would change the document.

abapCleaner.lint.run.description: When to refresh ABAP Cleaner diagnostics.

abapCleaner.rules.EXPORTING_KEYWORD.enab.description: Override the active profile for Omit optional EXPORTING.

abapCleaner.rules.CLOSING_BRACKETS_POSIT.description: Override the active profile for Close brackets at line end.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_EQUALS_BOOLEAN..description: Override the active profile for Use assert_true and assert_false.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_CLASS.assertCla.description: Class called by bounded ASSERT_CLASS modernization.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_EQUALS_SUBRC.en.description: Override the active profile for Use assert_subrc instead of assert_equals.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_PARAMETER_ORDER.description: Override the active profile for Standardize assertion parameter order.

abapCleaner.rules.STRING_TEMPLATE.enable.description: Override the active profile for Use string templates to assemble text.

abapCleaner.rules.CHECK_IN_LOOP.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Convert CHECK in loop to IF NOT ... CONTINUE.

abapCleaner.rules.CHECK_OUTSIDE_LOOP.ena.description: Override the active profile for Convert CHECK outside loop to IF NOT ... RETURN.

abapCleaner.rules.CALL_METHOD.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Replace CALL METHOD with functional call.

abapCleaner.rules.ABAP_DOC_LANG.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Remove lang="en" from ABAP Doc.

abapCleaner.rules.IMPLICIT_TYPE.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Make implicit type explicit.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_CLEAR.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Remove needless CLEAR.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_SECTIONS.enabled.description: Enable removal of empty protected sections from final local classes.

abapCleaner.rules.CALCULATION_ASSIGNMENT.description: Enable calculation assignments for ABAP 7.54 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.ADD_TO_ETC.enabled.description: Enable ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, and DIVIDE modernization for ABAP 7.54 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.CREATE_OBJECT.enabled.description: Enable CREATE OBJECT modernization for ABAP 7.40 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.CONDENSE.enabled.description: Enable bounded CONDENSE modernization for ABAP 7.02 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.DESCRIBE_TABLE.enabled.description: Enable bounded DESCRIBE TABLE LINES modernization.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_COMMAND.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Remove standalone empty commands.

abapCleaner.rules.END_OF_COMMENT.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Remove end-of comments.

abapCleaner.rules.EQUALS_SIGN_CHAIN.enab.description: Override the active profile for Resolve equals sign chain into several commands.

abapCleaner.rules.EXIT_OUTSIDE_LOOP.enab.description: Override the active profile for Replace EXIT outside loop with RETURN.

abapCleaner.rules.MOVE_TO.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Replace obsolete MOVE TO with =.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_PARENTHESES.e.description: Override the active profile for Remove needless parentheses.

abapCleaner.rules.PRAGMA_POSITION.enable.description: Override the active profile for Move pragmas to correct position.

abapCleaner.rules.PSEUDO_COMMENT.enabled.description: Enable unambiguous trailing pseudo-comment modernization for ABAP 7.02 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.RAISE_TYPE.enabled.description: Enable RAISE TYPE modernization for ABAP 7.52 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.TYPO.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Correct frequent typos.

abapCleaner.rules.TRANSLATE.enabled.description: Enable bounded TRANSLATE upper/lower modernization for ABAP 7.02 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.RECEIVING_KEYWORD.enab.description: Override the active profile for Omit RECEIVING.

abapCleaner.rangeFormatting.expandMode.description: Code boundary expanded by Format Selection; FULL_CONTROL_BLOCK selects the innermost IF, loop, CASE, TRY, SELECT, or PROVIDE block, and FULL_CLASS also covers interface blocks.

abapCleaner.rules.COMPARISON_OPERATOR.en.description: Override the active profile for Use consistent set of comparison operators.

abapCleaner.rules.CHAIN_OF_ONE.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Simplify a chain with one element.

abapCleaner.rules.CHAIN_OF_ONE.processSi.description: Override whether to simplify eligible one-line chains.

abapCleaner.rules.DECLARATION_CHAIN.enab.description: Override the active profile for Unchain into multiple statements.

abapCleaner.rules.NOT_IS.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Prefer IS NOT to NOT IS.

abapCleaner.rules.ONE_COMMAND_PER_LINE.e.description: Override the active profile for Move commands to own lines.

abapCleaner.rules.LOGICAL_OPERATOR_POSIT.description: Override the active profile for Move AND/OR etc. from line end to next line start.

abapCleaner.rules.SELF_REFERENCE_ME.enab.description: Override the active profile for Remove the self-reference me->.

abapCleaner.rules.READ_TABLE.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Replace READ TABLE with table expression.

abapCleaner.rules.VALUE_STATEMENT.enable.description: Override the active profile for Shorten VALUE statements.

abapCleaner.rules.COMMENT_TYPE.enabled.description: Override the active profile for Comment with " instead of * for prose.

abapCleaner.rules.UPPER_AND_LOWER_CASE.e.description: Override the active profile for Convert upper and lower case.

abapCleaner.rules.ABAP_DOC_PARAMETERS.en.description: Override the active profile for Add missing parameters to ABAP Doc.

abapCleaner.rules.CLASS_DEFINITION.enabl.description: Override the active profile for Standardize CLASS ... DEFINITION.

abapCleaner.rules.IF_BLOCK_AT_METHOD_END.description: Override the active profile for Replace long IF blocks at method end.

abapCleaner.rules.IF_BLOCK_AT_LOOP_END.e.description: Override the active profile for Replace long IF blocks at loop end.

abapCleaner.rules.CAMEL_CASE_IN_CDS_TEST.description: Override the active profile for Use CamelCase in test class for CDS view.

abapCleaner.rules.CDS_TEST_CLASS_LINES.e.description: Override the active profile for Standardize test classes for CDS views.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_IN_CLASS_D.description: Override the active profile for Standardize empty lines in class definitions.
Override maximum consecutive blank lines in class definitions.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_OUTSIDE_ME.description: Override the active profile for Separate methods and classes with empty lines.
Override blank lines directly between class or interface blocks.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_WITHIN_MET.description: Override the active profile for Standardize empty lines within methods.
Override the maximum consecutive blank lines within methods.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_SPACES.enable.description: Override the active profile for Remove needless spaces.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_SPACES.proces.description: Override whether to remove excess whitespace from empty parentheses and brackets.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACES_IN_EMPTY_BRACKE.description: Override the active profile for Put spaces around text literals.
Override whether to separate text literals from keywords.
Override whether to separate text literals from operators.
Override whether to separate text literals from comments.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACE_BEFORE_PERIOD.en.description: Override the active profile for Remove space before commas and period.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACE_BEFORE_PERIOD.ex.description: Override whether to remove spaces before chain commas.
Override whether to remove spaces before statement periods.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACE_AROUND_COMMENT_S.description: Override the active profile for Put spaces around comment sign.
Override whether to separate code and a comment sign.
Override whether to start a comment with a space.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository --out abap-cleaner-vscode-dev.vsix
